desc.words: One huge word at a time, the last stays, then a line
desc.compare: "Elsewhere" panel with crosses, then "here" panel with checks
desc.steps: Numbered steps joined by a drawing line
desc.spotlight: One picture as a card with slow zoom, name tag
desc.quote: Big quote word by word, attribution (real quotes only)
desc.cards: Feature cards fanning out of a stack
desc.greetings: Cycles through words (any script), lands on the last
desc.heroSplit: Photo on one half, headline on the other
desc.heroSlides: Photo carousel on one half, headline on the other
desc.heroPoster: Giant stacked words, alternating fill and accent
desc.heroCollage: Five polaroids drop into a pile, headline beside it
desc.carousel: Coverflow cards that advance by themselves (about 1 s per card)
desc.bento: Mixed-size tile grid; tile 1 is big and can be a photo
desc.chat: Message bubbles with typing dots (no made-up testimonials)
desc.stats: 2 to 4 numbers counting up with colour bars (real numbers only)
desc.marquee: Giant text rows scrolling in opposite directions, a line in front
desc.wipe: Before/after card with a sweeping divider
desc.offer: Price card: old price struck, new price, badge, deadline
desc.endMosaic: Dimmed wall of pictures behind a CTA card
desc.endMarquee: Two benefit rows scrolling around logo and CTA
desc.heroWave: Live waveform under a headline, optional track card
desc.walkthrough: A finger (portrait) or cursor (landscape) taps through real screens
desc.lockscreen: Phone shows the app, locks, a now-playing card keeps going
desc.embedDemo: Embed code types out, players appear in a blog post
desc.deck: Cards dealt off a stack, flipped into a fan
desc.sleeve: Album cover slides in, a vinyl slides out and spins
desc.adSpot: A video player shows a spot, a ticker and a banner
desc.tabs: A browser flips through real pages as tabs
desc.growth: An upward curve with "+1" bubbles and a Join pill (illustration, no numbers)
desc.frontends: Browser windows cascade in, each another site with the same banner
desc.map: Dotted world map, pins drop at real places, arcs fly
desc.receipt: A slip prints line by line, a total, a stamp (real values only)
desc.timeline: A line draws itself, milestones pop, "now" pulses
desc.phoneStack: Three phones fan in, each scrolls its own tall screenshot
desc.spotlightGrid: Dimmed 3x3 grid, a round spotlight glides from pick to pick
desc.stopwatch: A dial sweeps while the readout counts, snaps to a result
desc.split3: Three full-height panels slide in, a word on each
desc.ticket: An event ticket slides in, the stub tears off, a stamp lands
desc.magnifier: A lens glides over a screenshot and enlarges details
desc.flow: Nodes joined by drawing lines, dots travel along them
desc.countdown: Split-flap cards flip down to the real value
desc.poll: A poll card: bars fill, the winner gets a check (real numbers only)
desc.badge: A medal drops in on a ribbon, rays turn, confetti
desc.checklist: Items tick off one by one, a counter and bar fill
desc.search: A search box types the query, results drop in
desc.calendar: A month grid; active days light up, a streak counter runs
desc.cube: A 3D cube turns face by face, a word on each
desc.podium: Three columns rise, avatars land, the winner gets a crown (real people, with permission)
desc.zoomReveal: Starts deep inside a detail and pulls back to the whole picture
desc.kinetic: Words slam in at different sizes and angles, then a line
desc.videoRow: Three 16:9 video cards drop in, a word on each
desc.compose: A post composer types, posts, collects reactions
desc.profile: A person spotlight: avatar ring, name, handle, chips (real people only)
desc.logo: Logo with three drawn rings, letter-spaced wordmark
desc.wall: Tilted wall of pictures panning, headline over a shade
desc.product: Screenshot in a browser frame with feature chips
desc.hook: Opening statement, readable by 0.5 s; optional picture marquee
desc.stat: A number counting up in a ring (real numbers only)
desc.phone: Mobile screenshot in a phone frame with up to 4 chips
desc.points: Headline and up to 4 icon rows
